turns.prompt:
No mode questions, do not use Skill.
Use the PowerShell tool, not Bash. Run each step as its own tool call, with the command exactly as written:
1) New-Item -ItemType File -Force .\ps-a.txt
2) the same exact command as step 1 again
3) New-Item -ItemType File -Force .\ps-b.txt
4) New-Item -ItemType File -Force $env:TEMP\plenum-ps-x.txt
5) the same exact command as step 4 again
6) New-Item -ItemType File -Force '{TMP}\plenum-ps-y.txt'
7) the same exact command as step 6 again
8) New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .\sub
9) Set-Location .\sub
10) the same exact command as step 1 again (now inside sub)
Do not save anything to files or memory except these commands. Then reply DONE and, for each step, whether you were asked for permission.
